tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Ground of every post, slide and chart. Warm, uncoated-paper cream; never pure white.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: A panel lifted off `paper`: a chart plate or a table inside a post. Use sparingly; most posts are one flat ground.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Recessed bands: a table's header row, a callout strip. Body text in `ink` or `ink-muted` only (red text fails on it below 24px).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Titles, body copy, chart zero lines and axis baselines. Reads on `paper`, `paper-raised`, `paper-sunk`, `red-tint` and `green-tint` in both themes (≥10:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Standfirsts' secondary lines, axis tick labels, source lines, bylines. Reads on `paper`, `paper-raised`, `paper-sunk` and both tints (≥5:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines and hairline dividers only — never text, never a border that carries meaning (it is deliberately faint, 1.6:1).

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: The stamp vermilion: THE accent. The top-left tab, the one highlighted bar or line, a key number. Text in `red` only on `paper` or `paper-raised` (≥4.5:1), or at 24px+ on `paper-sunk`. At most one red thing per post, plus the tab.

tokens.name: on-red
tokens.usage: Text and marks set on a `red` fill (5.2:1 light, 5.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: red-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet fill behind a highlighted table row or annotation band. `ink` text on it.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: The stamp green: the brand's field colour. Full-bleed cover posts, series-1 in charts, the default Stamp. Text in `green` on `paper` and `paper-raised` (≥5:1).

tokens.name: on-green
tokens.usage: Text and the tab on a `green` field (5.8:1 light, 7.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: green-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet fill behind a callout or a shaded chart period (e.g. a recession band). `ink` text on it.

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: First (or only) data series: bars and lines. Label it directly in `series-1`.

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: Second series, navy — darker than `series-1` in light, lighter in dark, so the two part by lightness, not hue alone. Label in `series-2`.

tokens.name: series-3
tokens.usage: Third series, ochre. A mark colour (3.4:1 on `paper`): label it in `ink`, not in ochre, in the light theme.

tokens.name: series-4
tokens.usage: Fourth series and the 'everything else' grey behind a highlighted line. A mark colour: label it in `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: The one series, bar or point the post is about. Everything else drops to `series-1` or `series-4`.

tokens.name: stamp-paper
tokens.usage: The perforated paper margin of a Stamp. Stays light in the dark theme: a stamp is a physical object.

tokens.name: stamp-red
tokens.usage: Field of a red Stamp — the vermilion sampled from the 1920s Dutch 7½-cent stamp. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: stamp-green
tokens.usage: Field of a green Stamp — the green of the 2½-cent stamp. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: stamp-ochre
tokens.usage: The Bauhaus yellow: third icon field and the accent shape in icons. Same in both themes. Only `stamp-ink` lines or text go on it (7.6:1); never paper or white (2.2:1). Never a text colour.

tokens.name: stamp-ink
tokens.usage: Fixed black for icon fields and for figures on `stamp-ochre`. It doesn't flip in the dark theme, because icons are printed objects like the stamps.

tokens.name: on-stamp
tokens.usage: Lettering on `stamp-red` (5.2:1) and `stamp-green` (5.8:1).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Carousel covers and one-idea posts. Always UPPERCASE, 1–5 words, max three lines on 1080px.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Default post title on a 1080 × 1350 portrait. UPPERCASE.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Titles on landscape (1200 × 627) posts and carousel inner slides. UPPERCASE.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: The single number a post is about, and the value inside a Stamp.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: The label above a title: series name and number. UPPERCASE, `ink-muted` (or `on-green` on a green field).

styles.name: standfirst
styles.sample: Most AI projects stall between the demo and the P&L. Here is where ours did.
styles.usage: The one- or two-sentence dek under a title. Sentence case, no full stop needed if one line.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We started with the monthly report because everyone hated writing it.
styles.usage: Running text on text-heavy carousel slides. Max ~60 words a slide.

styles.name: quote
styles.usage: Pull quotes (Quote component). Curly quotes, hung into the margin.

styles.name: chart-title
styles.usage: Chart title: a short claim, sentence case (the chart is not a post title, so no uppercase).

styles.name: chart-subtitle
styles.usage: What is measured, where, and the unit. `ink`.

styles.name: chart-label
styles.usage: Axis ticks and category labels. `ink-muted` for ticks, `ink` for categories.

styles.name: chart-value
styles.usage: Direct labels on bars and line ends, in the series colour.

styles.name: source
styles.usage: Source and footnote lines, bottom-left, `ink-muted`. Every chart has one.

styles.name: byline
styles.usage: The signature in every post footer. UPPERCASE.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tick-to-label gaps, tab-to-kicker nudges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Kicker to title; title to standfirst; bar gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a chart's subtitle and its plot; between footer items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a post (standfirst → chart).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Header to body on portrait posts.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: The post margin on all four sides of a 1080px canvas. Nothing but the tab and full-bleed fields enters it.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Width of the red tab; big pauses on cover posts.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything by default: posts, bars, panels, the tab. The system is square.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: The only softening allowed: small tags and legend keys.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Data points (line-end dots) only.

size.note: Canvas sizes in export pixels. Build at these sizes and export PNG (single) or PDF (carousel).

tokens.name: canvas-width
tokens.usage: Width of portrait and square posts and carousel slides.

tokens.name: canvas-portrait
tokens.usage: Height of the default 4:5 portrait post — the most feed space LinkedIn gives an image. Use it unless there is a reason not to.

tokens.name: canvas-square
tokens.usage: Height of a 1:1 post: quotes, single stamps.

tokens.name: canvas-landscape-w
tokens.usage: Width of the 1.91:1 landscape (link/article) image.

tokens.name: canvas-landscape-h
tokens.usage: Height of the 1.91:1 landscape image.

tokens.name: tab-height
tokens.usage: Height of the red tab flush to the top edge of every post and framed chart.

stroke.note: Line weights at export scale (they halve on screen).

tokens.name: stroke-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines, in `rule`.

tokens.name: stroke-axis
tokens.usage: Zero line / baseline, in `ink`.

tokens.name: stroke-rule
tokens.usage: The ink rule across the top of a framed chart.

tokens.name: stroke-series
tokens.usage: Lines in a line chart.

shadow.note: One shadow in the whole system, and only for the one physical object.

tokens.name: shadow-stamp
tokens.usage: Lifts a Stamp off the page (applied as a drop-shadow so it follows the perforations). Nothing else casts a shadow.
